mapper.select: select bh.id, bh.user_id, bh.seat_id, bh.browse_time, ri.seat_code, ri.price, ai.name store_name, ai.district_name, ai.city_name, ai.province_name from browsing_history bh left join seat ri on bh.seat_id = ri.id and ri.is_deleted = 0 left join study_store ai on ri.store_id = ai.id and ai.is_deleted = 0 where bh.is_deleted = 0 and bh.user_id = #{userId} order by bh.browse_time desc
select url, name from graph_info where is_deleted = 0 and item_type = 2 and item_id = #{seat_id}
